args.title: venice: full repository requirements audit v1 (matrices, evidence ledger, corrected Gantt, tests)
args.body:
## What this delivers
Adds `docs/venice-audit-v1/` — a traceable audit of every checklist-engine requirement against immutable main evidence, built only from four pinned authority files.

### Artifacts
- `DATA_REQUIREMENTS.csv` — 19-column per-inventory-id matrix, 258 rows, `required_or_excluded` (C28/C29 are declared control exclusions, not gaps).
- `REQUIREMENTS.csv` — 11-column requirement matrix; every `authority_path` is pinned as `path@40hexsha` or resolves to a real repo file.
- `GANTT_COMPARISON.csv` — 13-column reconciliation of the v16 chart (`e85547ac`) and the skeptical v20 chart (`2ba3ebdf`) across 62 baseline rows, including the D2 split and reverse requirement mappings.
- `EVIDENCE.json` — snapshot block (`branch`, `main_head_observed`, `spec_audit_base`, `delta_note`) plus entries separating claim / artifact path / blob sha / check performed / result / coverage scope / limits.
- `GANTT.html` — regenerated from `GANTT_COMPARISON.csv`; the generator aborts if any baseline row id is missing; it states no completion percentage.
- `AUDIT.md` — dependency-ordered report, sections 1–9, with the delta between audit base `68c6f2a8` and live main `c30c23be`.
- `SOURCE_MANIFEST.json` — row count and the four authority blob shas (`9412f478`, `c9d9af05`, `fa338f19`, `756f6a36`).
- `PROGRESS.json` — durable checkpoint for this lane.

### Tests
`tests/test_repo_requirements_audit.py` asserts only properties the builder derives from the authority files: exact column contracts for all three CSVs, id uniqueness, non-empty acceptance conditions, blob-pinned authority paths, split rows whose `split_from` resolves to a present row, evidence entries carrying non-empty `limits` and `coverage_scope`, and a skip-guarded check that `GANTT.html` never states a fabricated `% complete`.

### Evidence
Push run on `venice/repo-requirements-audit-v1` at `e3eba97e` is green with no error annotation: https://github.com/SRoyaltyy/checklist-engine/actions/runs/42556696754

### Scope
Evidence audit only. No catalog row is treated as a download, no access test as acquisition, and this PR opens no world/scoring/live gate. Sealed records, receipts, other lanes' inventories and production pipelines are untouched.

Gantt row advanced: all project stages 0–8 (evidence audit).
